Now,  therefore,  in  exercise  of  the  powers  conferred  by  section  2CC  of  the   
Securities and  Exchange Ordinance, 1969 (XVII of 1969), the  Commission hereby 
amends the following condition to its earlier Notification No. BSEC/CMRRCD/2006-

2018 and Notification No. BSEC/CMRRCD/2009-193/66/PRD/148, dated 16 October 
2023 as published in the official gazette on 20 November 2023, namely:-
